```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

> This page is `brand/en/package-guide.md` in kitDesign (the English translation of `brand/套件開發須知.md`).

```{r, results = "asis"}
md <- readLines(file.path("..", "..", "brand", "en", "package-guide.md"), encoding = "UTF-8")
md <- md[-1]  # the title is already shown above
md <- md[!grepl("^English \\| \\[", md)]  # the language switch line: the site uses the navbar
gh <- "https://github.com/jiewenTsai/kitDesign/blob/main/brand/en/"
md <- gsub("](release.md)", "](release.html)", md, fixed = TRUE)
md <- gsub("](design-language.md)", "](design-language.html)", md, fixed = TRUE)
md <- gsub("](migration.md)", paste0("](", gh, "migration.md)"), md, fixed = TRUE)
cat(md, sep = "\n")
```
